g.text: Eave heights: spec roof.profile full_curve (|u| 23-123 m), extended linearly
to the 34.9 m tip; the profile is symmetric by fit (north and south halves
pooled). The centre-section silhouette (dashed) rests on one photo.
Below the eave the west wall is drawn as one glass field: no mullion module,
fascia depth or canopy line is published.
The north end elevation shows what is known; the lower building masses and the
end wall outline need SFO record drawings.
